terms.gloss: at a run, at full speed
terms.grammar: ablative of curriculum used as an adverb
evidence: Plaut. Mil. 2.6.43; Ter. Heaut. 4.4.11 (Lewis & Short s.v. curriculum)
terms.comment: The ablative of “running”: abī curriculō, off you go at a run; eāmus illūc curriculō, let’s run over there.

phrases.english: Let’s go there on the double!

sources: John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 115, 119, 127, 306.
